source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: We employed approximately 306,000 people worldwide as of December 27, 2025, including approximately 125,000 people within the United States.

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The median employee’s total compensation was $53,296. ■ The total compensation was calculated in the same manner in which we determine the compensation shown for our NEOs in the Summary Compensation Table, including the value of retirement benefits.

notes: Employees: approximate year-end count from the FY2025 10-K. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 (the last completed fiscal year) is used; it includes the value of retirement benefits, and PepsiCo notes that employees in 79 countries and currency movements affect it.
